case_number: 2025 INSC 83; CIVIL APPEAL NO.183 OF 2025 [Arising out of SLP(C) NO. 17120 OF 2022]
summary: Disciplinary proceedings initiated 11 days pre-retirement; charges: non-compliance with Election Commission, unauthorized leave, pulse polio program failure, threats to senior assistant; inquiry officer found charges 1-4 proved except threat allegation; pension cut penalty imposed; High Court modified penalty from permanent 2% cut to 5-year cut; Supreme Court upheld High Court's proportionality finding; mala fide allegations considered but not determinative; penalty modification sustained as non-shocking conscience.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upheld; penalty modified to 2% pension cut for 5 years.
